golem.material.text.primalartifice.alkim: Light, fireproof and blastproof, but fragile.
jei.primalartifice.info.alkimium_centrif: Splits compound essentia from below into all of its components, sent out of the top. Stopped by redstone.
jei.primalartifice.info.alkimium_goggles: Goggles of revealing that are also a helmet (3 armour, 2 toughness) and give an 8% vis discount. Sneak to read the essentia and suction of what you look at. Curios head slot.
jei.primalartifice.info.alkimium_smelter: Fits a smelter like the auxiliary pump, but moves three essentia per cycle into the alembics above it.
Fits a smelter like the venting port, but filters half of the flux it would release.
A Thaumaturge essentia smelter that smelts every 10 ticks and keeps 85% of the essentia.
Smelts every 5 ticks and keeps 95% of the essentia.
Smelts every 10 ticks and keeps all of the essentia, so it makes no flux.
jei.primalartifice.info.aura_meter: While it is in your inventory or a Curios charm slot, the chunk's vis and flux show on the HUD. Sneak to read the numbers.
jei.primalartifice.info.bismuth_claymore: Crafted with Metaphize II: experience from mobs it kills becomes vis in the chunk.
jei.primalartifice.info.flawless_focus: A spell focus beyond Greater: complexity 120, depth 18, 6 branches, 6 repeats.
jei.primalartifice.info.flawless_mirror: A magic mirror that turns instability into flux only once per 512 and sheds it every 20 ticks.
jei.primalartifice.info.flawless_mirror_: An essentia mirror that turns instability into flux only once per 512 and sheds it every 20 ticks.
jei.primalartifice.info.glass_cutter: Use it on any glass block or pane to take it whole. 100 uses; repair with quartz.
jei.primalartifice.info.glass_cutter_vis: Use it on glass to take the block whole. Runs on vis charge (five cuts per charge, 100 charges); refill it on a Recharge Pedestal.
jei.primalartifice.info.glass_entity: Living things walk through it; items, arrows and everything else bump into it.
jei.primalartifice.info.glass_ethereal: Use a vis crystal on it to set an aspect. Only creatures that carry every aspect set in it can walk through. Sneak-use with an empty hand to clear it.
jei.primalartifice.info.glass_hardened: Blast resistance 2000: explosions leave it standing.
jei.primalartifice.info.glass_non_living: Items, arrows, minecarts and other non-living things pass through it; creatures cannot.
jei.primalartifice.info.glass_redstone: Gives off a redstone signal of 15 on every side.
jei.primalartifice.info.mirromirous_head: Curios head: halves experience orbs and turns the rest into research knowledge. 3% vis discount.
jei.primalartifice.info.mirrored_amulet: Use on a magic mirror to bind it. Curios necklace: your drops on death go into that mirror. 3% vis discount.
jei.primalartifice.info.mirrored_jar: Jars with the same link share one essentia store. Use the item on a placed jar to copy its link; sneak-use in the air to clear the link.
jei.primalartifice.info.starving_chest_h: A hungry chest that also draws in dropped items from 4 blocks around, when it has room.
jei.primalartifice.info.starving_chest_l: A hungry chest that also draws in dropped items from 3 blocks around, when it has room.
jei.primalartifice.info.starving_chest_m: A hungry chest that also draws in dropped items from 2 blocks around, when it has room.
jei.primalartifice.info.starving_chest_s: A hungry chest that also draws in dropped items from 1 block around, when it has room.
jei.primalartifice.info.suspension_belt: Curios belt: no fall damage, sneak to sink slowly, jump to hover. 5% vis discount.
jei.primalartifice.info.wand_cap_bismuth: Wand cap: 10% less vis on everything, 15% less on the primals.
pack.primalartifice.extra_aspects: Primal Artifice: Spatio, Tempus and Tinctura aspects
pack.primalartifice.extra_aspects.title: Primal Artifice Extra Aspects
primalartifice.glass_cutter.empty: The cutter has no vis charge left
primalartifice.mirrored_jar.linked: The jar now shares its essentia
research.primalartifice.alchemical_glass: A cutter that wears out is a poor tool for a thaumaturge. Amber and alkimium could let it run on vis.
The Alchemical Glass Cutter never breaks. Each vis charge it holds is good for five cuts, and it holds a hundred charges. Refill it on a Recharge Pedestal.
research.primalartifice.alkimium.stage_0: Brass is the metal of every alchemical device I own, and it is the reason they leak. Brass tempered in alkimia and ordo might hold essentia the way glass holds water.
research.primalartifice.alkimium.stage_1: A brass ingot in a crucible of alkimia and ordo becomes Alkimium. Like any metal it can be pressed into plates, and it is the heart of every Alkimium device.
research.primalartifice.alkimium.title: Alkimium
research.primalartifice.alkimium_applica: Every smelter I have built loses a part of what it melts down, and the loss becomes flux. An alkimium lining should keep much more of it.

The Alkimic Construct is alkimium plating around tubes and valves, the frame of every Alkimium device. An Alkimium Smeltery works like an essentia smelter but runs faster (a smelt every 10 ticks) and keeps 85% of each item's essentia. Alembics, pumps and vents attach to it just as they do to any smelter.
research.primalartifice.alkimium_centrif: The essentia centrifuge splits a compound and throws half of it away. Spun in alkimium, nothing need be lost.
The Alkimium Centrifuge takes compound essentia from a tube below and sends every one of its components out of the top, not just one of them. A redstone signal stops it.
research.primalartifice.alkimium_distill: A pump and a vent can be made of alkimium too, and they should work harder for it.

The Alkimium Auxiliary Slurry Pump fits any smelter like the ordinary pump and moves three essentia into its alembics each cycle instead of one. The Alkimium Venting Port filters half of the flux a smelter would release, against a third for the ordinary vent; several stack.
research.primalartifice.alkimium_goggles: My goggles show me what essentia sits in a jar. Alkimium lenses and a resonator could show me where it wants to go.

Alkimium Goggles of Revealing reveal everything the ordinary goggles do, protect like a good helmet (3 armour, 2 toughness), and take 8% off the vis cost of spells and arcane crafting. Sneak while looking at a jar, tube or other essentia block to read its contents and suction. They also fit a Curios head slot.
research.primalartifice.alkimium_thaumiu: Thaumium sped up the old smelter. Wrapped around an alkimium one it should do better still.
The Thaumium Alkimium Smeltery smelts every 5 ticks and keeps 95% of the essentia.
research.primalartifice.alkimium_void_sm: Void metal swallows what would otherwise escape. An alkimium smeltery lined with it might lose nothing.
The Void Alkimium Smeltery smelts every 10 ticks and keeps all of the essentia: nothing is lost and no flux comes of it.
research.primalartifice.bismuth.stage_0: Thaumium drinks in the aura, but it does not hold it well. Soaked in more auram and potentia it might become something that does.
research.primalartifice.bismuth.stage_1: A thaumium ingot in a crucible of auram and potentia becomes Bismuth, a metal that rings with vis. Bismuth plates and mirrored glass make an Aura Meter: keep it in your inventory or a charm slot to see the chunk's vis and flux at all times, and sneak to read the numbers. The Bismuth Claymore comes from the workbench already bearing Metaphize II.
research.primalartifice.bismuth.title: Bismuth
research.primalartifice.bismuth_caster.s: Gauntlets are not my tradition, but the bismuth that would have lined one would make a fine wand cap.
Bismuth nuggets shape inert Bismuth Caps, which infusion charges. A wand with bismuth caps spends 10% less vis on everything and 15% less on the primals.
research.primalartifice.emissive_glass.s: If glass can be taught to be clearer, it can be taught to hold other things: light, even a steady spark of power.

Four glass with five crystals make four panes. Light Glass (lux) shines as brightly as glowstone. For glass that stops all light, plain Tinted Glass already does it. Redstone Glass (potentia) gives off a full redstone signal on every side, like a block of redstone you can look through.
research.primalartifice.essentia_manipul: Grinding crystals for salis mundus is slow. Redstone already carries the spark it needs.
Drop redstone into a crucible holding praecantatio to get salis mundus, one for one.
research.primalartifice.flawless_foci.st: A greater focus still has a grain to it, flaws that limit how much a spell can be. A focus grown around a primordial pearl might have none.
A Flawless Focus holds spells of up to 120 complexity, with deeper trees, more branches and more repeats than a greater focus. Assemble it in the focal manipulator like any other.
research.primalartifice.flawless_mirrors: Every mirror I have made leaks flux as things pass through it. A primordial pearl set in alkimium and bismuth might seal the flaw.

Flawless Magic and Essentia Mirrors work like the ordinary ones but hold four times as much instability before it becomes flux (one flux per 512), and shed it five times faster. Hand mirrors link to them too.
research.primalartifice.glassworking.sta: Glass is only sand that has forgotten itself in the fire. A little order, a touch of the right crystal, and it could be made clearer, harder, or stranger.

Eight glass around a vis crystal makes Clear Glass (sensus) or Crystal Glass (vitreus, without borders). Hardened Glass takes obsidian and a praemunio crystal and laughs at explosions. None of them drop unless broken with silk touch, or lifted whole with a Glass Cutter, which takes any glass block in one use and wears out after a hundred.
research.primalartifice.golem_mat_alkimi: Alkimium is light, it does not burn and it shrugs off blasts. It would make a strange golem: tough in some ways, brittle in others.
Alkimium is now a golem material in the golem press, with an alkimium plate as its base. Alkimium golems are light, fireproof and blastproof, with high armour (12) but fragile frames.
research.primalartifice.metal_transmutat: Bismuth is restless. It will take on the shape of almost any metal if coaxed.
In the crucible a bismuth ingot becomes iron (metallum), gold (desiderium) or quicksilver (alkimia).
research.primalartifice.mirromirous_head: The Curiosity Band trades experience for insight. Bismuth reflects; a band of it should reflect twice as much back into my mind.

Worn in a Curios head slot, the Mirromirous Headband halves the experience orbs you pick up and turns the rest into research knowledge, twice as often as the Curiosity Band. It also takes 3% off vis costs.
If a mirror can take what I throw into it, it can take what I drop when I die.

Use the Mirrored Amulet on a magic mirror to bind it (use it again to unbind). Worn in a Curios necklace slot, it sends everything you drop on death into that mirror, as long as the mirror is loaded. It also takes 3% off vis costs.
research.primalartifice.mirrored_jar.sta: An essentia mirror sends essentia away. A jar built around one could hold essentia in two places at once.

Mirrored Jars that share a link share one store of essentia: fill one and every linked jar fills. Use a Mirrored Jar item on a placed one to give it the same link, and sneak-use the item in the air to clear its link.
A wall need not stop everything. Glass steeped in the right essence could choose what passes.

Living Glass (spiritus) lets living things walk through and stops everything else. Non-living Glass (fabrico) is the reverse: items, arrows and minecarts pass, creatures do not. Ethereal Glass (praecantatio) starts solid. Use vis crystals on it to set aspects; then only creatures that carry all of those aspects may pass. Sneak and use it with an empty hand to clear it.
The more I learn of the aura, the more I see how crude my instruments are. My smelters waste essentia, my mirrors leak flux, and my glass is cloudy. There is room here for finer work.

Four paths open from here. Glassworking refines glass itself. Bismuth and its reagents bend the aura into metal. Alkimium perfects the essentia machinery, and the Mirromirous arts teach mirrors to carry more than light. Some steps on one path draw on what the others teach.
research.primalartifice.planar_infusion_: Infusion can press an enchantment into a tool. It ought to press one into a book as well, so that the enchantment can go on whatever I choose.

Infusing a book makes an enchanted book that goes on at an anvil. Metaphize (I to III, each level infused from the one before) turns the experience of mobs you kill into vis for the chunk, 30% per level, while the chunk's vis is below 110% of its base. Mirrored goes on tools and weapons: sneak-use the tool on a magic mirror to link it, and the drops of blocks it breaks and mobs it kills are sent into that mirror.
research.primalartifice.reagent_transmut: Most reagents I use are only cousins of one another. With the right essentia in the crucible one could turn into another.

In the crucible: spider eye into ender eye (vitreus, ignis, alienis); gunpowder into redstone (potentia) or blaze powder (praecantatio, ignis); quicksilver into amber (vinculum), and amber back into quicksilver (alkimia).
research.primalartifice.starving_chest.s: A hungry chest eats what falls on it. Fed bismuth, a hopper and a filter, it should grow hungry enough to pull its food in.

Each Starving Chest is infused from the size before it, starting from a hungry chest. It eats what lands on it like a hungry chest and also draws dropped items towards itself from 1, 2, 3 or 4 blocks around and above, but only items it has room for.
The levitator holds things up in a column of air. Bound into a belt it could hold me up wherever I go.
Worn in a Curios belt slot, the Belt of Suspension stops all fall damage. Hold sneak to sink slowly, or hold jump to hang in the air. It also takes 5% off vis costs.
research.primalartifice.thaumic_apple.st: A golden apple is a crude sort of alchemy. A thaumaturge can do better.

Steep a golden apple in praecantatio, victus, bestia and terra for Thaumaturge's Fruit: a minute of everything an enchanted golden apple gives. An enchanted golden apple, steeped in far more, gives a fifth longer than the apple alone and stronger regeneration.
